content:
kai-release: Planning a quick staged rollout at 03:00 UTC: api@v1.11.0, runtime@2.14.0, router@3.6.1. Console needs to add X-Canary and X-Session headers for canary routing.
nora-runtime: Runtime change enables a lighter kernel for prefetch and an opt-in batching path. Batching OFF by default for canary. Prefetch behind flag prefetch_v3.
eli-router: Router will honor X-Session and prefer sticky routes when present; falls back if missing. Console needs to set both headers for canary tokens.
zoe-console: I can add both headers in the proxy hotfix. Will open a small PR to a hotfix branch and attach deploy preview.
sam-eng: Recommend pinning api/runtime/router through the first two waves. Rollback triggers: 5xx > 0.45% for 5m OR regen p95 increase > +25% over baseline for 5m => rollback runtime only. Auto-hold if mem pressure > 80%.
deploy-bot: Scheduling deploy for kai-release at 03:00 UTC. Waves: 10% -> 30% -> 100%. Canary watchers: nora-runtime, eli-router, zoe-console.
kai-release: Please pin before first wave: `/deploy pin api@v1.11.0 runtime@2.14.0 router@3.6.1 --note "session-prefetch canary pin 03:00"`
deploy-bot: Pin command queued: `/deploy pin api@v1.11.0 runtime@2.14.0 router@3.6.1`. Confirm with :thumbsup:.
nora-runtime: :thumbsup:
eli-router: :thumbsup:
zoe-console: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Wave 1 (10%) started at 03:00:12 UTC. Monitors: latency, 5xx, sticky misses, mem pressure.
nora-runtime: Wave1 looks normal. Prefetch cold misses present. Batching OFF.
eli-router: Headers present. No sticky issues yet.
zoe-console: Preview green, headers set only for canary tokens.
deploy-bot: Wave 2 (30%) started at 03:07:40 UTC.
nora-runtime: At 30% regen p95 +9% baseline, mem 55%, 5xx 0.08%.
sam-eng: Hold 8m then proceed if stable.
deploy-bot: Wave 3 (100%) started at 03:18:05 UTC.
nora-runtime: After 100% p95 peaked at +14% then settled to +10%. No sustained 5xx. KV pressure normal.
eli-router: Sticky miss rate ~0.4% during canary, within tolerance.
zoe-console: Pushing release-note draft with header docs and prefetch flag note.
kai-release: Unpin api/router now, keep runtime pinned +20m for observation. `/deploy unpin api router`
deploy-bot: Commands executed. Runtime pinned until 03:38:05 UTC. Canary closed. :white_check_mark:
